subject: P19 built: ui654fb60dvfs 916e74b3, probe350dvfs 3628d122 (fix: rail preflight now the stock rule)
body:
P19 BUILT (host-only, NOT run, NOT flashed; needs the user's approval): fixes the P18 preflight refusal. Kernel p19a (series 0085..0117) sha256 9715063554cd8e1ccf6648707fa30147d6cd4888522bd91fdacc1919fda3a2c7; images in gpu/build/device-mmu-p19-candidate/:
- ui654fb60dvfs 916e74b3e112da8b4025ca188e9e1a0d272933e0937d3b6d049eab8e8f4d04ad (607 chars, "n2fbhz=60 n2dvfs=2000")
- probe350dvfs  3628d122eaf5eeab694a8c2d1e83a66626c1a4efb87c8db81b1df8a05584ef13 ("n2dvfs=1")
- ui654fb60 (fallback, same kernel, no DVFS) c01f8aac3e219d80f91cf819d3ad0852fbd83befed13fa1d0b7f1115d1cdb206
ROOT CAUSE of the c6t refusal (my rule was stricter than the vendor's): the stock driver checks the rails the bootloader left in exactly one place (_mt_cpufreq_pdrv_probe): Vsram >= Vproc and Vsram - Vproc <= MAX_DIFF_VSRAM_VPROC (250 mV). The constants I used as floors, MIN_VPROC_VOLT 600 mV and MIN_VSRAM_VOLT 850 mV, are floors for voltages the AP SETS itself (MAX(next_vsram, MIN_VSRAM_VOLT) in the non-hybrid path); the hybrid path never sets one. Your reading is the stock pairing: at the 650 mV row Vsram tracks Vproc + NORMAL_DIFF_VRSAM_VPROC (100 mV) = 750 mV, below the 850 mV AP floor. Decode (selectors 0x68 / MT6359P tracking) was right.
FIX (patch 0117): n2dv_rails_ok(): Vsram >= Vproc, Vsram - Vproc <= 250 mV, both within [500 mV, 1120 mV] (PMIC range starts at 500 mV, lowest table row is 650 mV: the floors only reject a garbage read); used by the preflight and by the cmd 10 builder. The preflight now reads and PRINTS ALL FOUR rails before the verdict (cluster L, B and CCI no longer hidden by an early return); the refusal text names the rule. B shares Vproc1/Vsram1 with L (650/750 mV at its row), CCI shares Vproc2/Vsram2 with LL.
TESTS with the exact device readings (LL/CCI 1000.00/1000.00 mV, L/B 650.00/750.00 mV): preflight passes, the four cmd 10 messages carry those values, all four rails logged, a refusal on L still prints B and CCI, exactly-250 mV passes and 250.01 mV is refused; mutations: the old 850 mV floor, a lower floor above 650 mV, an early return in the rail loop each fail the tests. run_all.sh gate on the P19 stage is queued behind another agent's gate; I will report it when it ends. Patch 0117-dvfs-preflight-rails-stock-rule.patch 29bdfe978f858046. README-0107-design.md section 14.
(Frontend note acknowledged: Metal pipelines refused by the AIR-only frontend is yours.)
